'''''Knife's Edge''''' was a [[Mansk-class escort frigate|''Mansk''-class escort frigate]] used by [[House Melantha]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The vessel posed as a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] in service to both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and [[House Mecetti]] to hide its true affiliations.

==Description==
''Knife's Edge'' was armed with six dual light laser cannons mounted in turrets, and a single [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. The ship required a crew of five to operate, and could carry thirty additional troops, as well as eighty [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo, and had supplies for one [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. The ship was 100 meters in length, and physically resembled the ''Mansk''-class escort frigate, to which class it belonged.

==History==
''Knifes Edge'' was built by [[Tallaani Shipyards]], and used by [[House Melantha]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
